title: New-note drafts are keyed by date, not by session
context: The parent spec's u3 stress fix keyed new-note drafts by a session id so an abandoned draft would not return to a later blank composer. The 2026-09-21 audit showed this breaks crash recovery: every open mints a fresh id, so the draft a crash leaves behind is never read and accumulates on disk. Discard and a successful save already delete the draft, so the only draft that can survive is crash-lost work.
options: keep session keys and add a scan for orphaned drafts on open
key new-note drafts by the composer's date as new-YYYY-MM-DD and make Delete all remove the drafts folder
key by a single global new-note key regardless of date
outcome: Key by date (new-YYYY-MM-DD). Reopening a composer for the same date restores the draft behind the existing inline chip; a different date does not see it, so a note is never saved under the wrong day. At most one orphan per date. Delete all now removes the drafts folder so a deleted journal cannot resurface through a draft. The edit route keeps keying by entry id. Specified in docs/specs/2026-09-21-note-fix-wave.md ruling W1; supersedes the u3 session-key stress fix.
